ablation.name: phase4h5a_eota_a07_mask25
ablation.notes: Phase 4H.5a: EOTA + alpha=0.7 + mask_ratio=0.25. Combines EOTA breakthrough with relaxed mask (less token dropout). Hypothesis: less aggressive masking preserves more style info, complementing EOTA's alpha control. Current SOTA uses mask_ratio=0.5.
